howto.what: 当用户问工作原理时,Claude 会解释:读、编辑、执行命令都会记成压缩观察;会话结束时总结,并把相关总结自动注入之后的对话。数据都存在本机 ~/.claude-mem,卸载时清除。
howto.when: 当用户询问 claude-mem 如何运作(如 how does claude-mem work?)或它在做什么(如 what is this thing doing?)时触发。

say.note: Claude 会讲解从观察到注入的记忆流程。

say.text: 我的记忆数据存放在哪里?
记忆注入什么时候开始?
say.note: Claude 会回答从某个项目的第二个会话开始。

howto.what_en: Claude explains that each Read/Edit/Bash becomes a compressed observation; session-end summaries are auto-injected later when relevant. Data stays locally in ~/.claude-mem and is removed on uninstall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

say_en.note: Claude says from the second session in a project.
